description: I'm the architect on a two-storey side-by-side duplex with a building area of 240 m2 and no dwelling above another. One wall is angled about 20 degrees to the side property line, so it runs from 1.2 m to 3.0 m away. For the window-area calculation we'd like to use the average distance of the wall, about 2.1 m, rather than drawing the plane at the closest point. One of the windows is at the 1.2 m end, in front of our proposed average-distance plane. Using the closest window plane cuts our glazing allowance by more than half.
known_facts: skewed wall 1.2 m to 3.0 m from the side property line
average distance 2.1 m proposed for unprotected-opening area
a glazed opening lies at the 1.2 m end in front of the proposed plane

gold.departure: Glazed-opening area for a skewed house wall calculated from a plane behind an actual glazed opening.

Permitted glazed-opening area after the plane is correctly located.
